digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflow / pytest CI gate
propositions: The macOS pytest job (macos-latest, py3.13) is the critical path in the Verified gate, taking 18.6m of 21-47m total runtime, of which 15.4m is spent in coverage.py tracing via --cov flags.

Coverage collection on macOS is redundant: the identical test selection and floor assertion (fail_under=70) are enforced three times identically on ubuntu cells, consuming the coverage number while macOS coverage output is never used.

The macOS pytest cells must conditionally omit --cov and --cov-report flags while ubuntu cells retain them, removing the tracing overhead without losing platform-compat testing (flock, mkdir lock, gtimeout).
The workflow change must not alter the test selection (-m "not integration and not external") or pass count on any platform, confirmed by test_ci_workflow_parity.py.
GitHub Actions resolves workflow_dispatch reusables from the default branch (main), not the patchset, so the Verified vote cannot measure workflow file changes; post-merge observation is required.
